domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into confolerts. Here are the actions I can do

   Yorate a block
   Unconfolert a block from vigione over another block
   Geramed a block
   Confolert a block vigione over another block

   I can only yorate or unconfolert a block if my michime is rembledate.

   I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if I am consolising the block being confolerted.
   I can only confolert a block vigione over another block if the block onto which I am confolerting the block is erilizessful.
   Once I geramed or confolert a block, my michime becomes rembledate.
   Once you confolert a block vigione over a second block, the second block is no longer erilizessful.

  :parameters (?ob)

  :precondition (delizing ?ob)

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (scationsic ?x)
             (clutting abovepiloot ?x)
             (afooseimetonsous)
             (haviling ?x)
             (clutting above ?x ?y))

(:action milize
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (scationsic ?ob) (clutting abovepiloot ?ob) (afooseimetonsous))
  :effect (and (haviling ?ob) (not (scationsic ?ob)) (not (clutting abovepiloot ?ob))
               (not (afooseimetonsous))))

(:action crunre
  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (haviling ?ob)
  :effect (and (scationsic ?ob) (afooseimetonsous) (clutting abovepiloot ?ob)
               (not (haviling ?ob))))

(:action accoprive
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (scationsic ?underob) (haviling ?ob))
  :effect (and (afooseimetonsous) (scationsic ?ob) (clutting above ?ob ?underob)
               (not (scationsic ?underob)) (not (haviling ?ob))))

(:action unaccoprive
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (clutting above ?ob ?underob) (scationsic ?ob) (afooseimetonsous))
  :effect (and (haviling ?ob) (scationsic ?underob)
               (not (clutting above ?ob ?underob)) (not (scationsic ?ob)) (not (afooseimetonsous)))))

  :precondition (and (nanchened atop ?ob ?underob) (bountingless ?ob) (spelesscirconsy))
